description: Adapt the v2.0.0 smoke test suite for Windows. Cover: app launch, helper spawn, capture start/stop (DXGI path), audio capture (WASAPI), encoder selection, export pipeline (MP4/WebM/GIF), hotkeys, tray icon, crop overlay, multi-monitor, save dialog, and clean shutdown. Include Windows-specific edge cases: UAC prompt during recording, display sleep/wake, remote desktop session, and Game Bar coexistence.
title: Windows smoke test suite
